title: Lurkers in the deep: How Canada's new submarines will be used in peace and potential war
description: The Canadian government has often spoken about the need for submarines to patrol Canada's vast coastline. But the role and range of of its new submarines go far beyond merely patrolling the three coasts of the country.
text:
The Canadian government has often spoken about the need for submarines to patrol Canada's vast coastline. "Canada's next submarine fleet will secure our coastlines and waters," Prime Minister Mark Carney said early last month in announcing the choice of Germany's ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems as the preferred bidder for the country's new underwater fleet. Patrolling Canada's three coasts will be part of the job for the fleet of up to a dozen state-of-the-art diesel-electric 212CD submarines, says retired vice-admiral Darren Hawco, who commanded Canada's Atlantic Fleet and served as the nation's military representative to NATO until 2020.

"With three oceans, the Arctic responsibilities, they're one of those strategic assets that we want to have." But Hawco says the subs — which are intended to replace the navy's aging Victoria Class fleet and could be ready by 2034 — will also travel the world. Why is Canada spending tens of billions on new submarines?

"มีสามมหาสมุทร, ความรับผิดชอบทางทวีปอาร์คติก, พวกเขาเป็นหนึ่งในทรัพย์สินยุทธศาสตร์ที่เราต้องการที่จะมี". แต่ฮอคโก้บอกว่าเรือดําน้ํา ที่มีเป้าหมายที่จะแทนเรือเก่าอายุของทัพเรือและอาจพร้อมในปี 2034 จะเดินทางไปยังทวีปอาร์คติก. ทำไมแคนาดาต้องใช้เงินหลายสิบล้าน สำหรับเรือดําน้ําใหม่?
